selection_reason: Background bank registration had better coverage than floor-only matching. A global floor correction fitted on three development frames reduced line error on the other seven marked frames.
identity_method: SAM2 local mask association with explicit assistant-reviewed identity fragments for the selected player; other IDs remain automatic fragments.
foot_method: Both pose ankles confident, bounding box not truncated at image bottom, ankle midpoint within current mask bounds. No bounding-box-bottom fallback.
camera_interpolation: Only between valid adjacent 5-frame keyframes with a bounded mapping change. No interpolation across invalid camera keys or the edited transition.
coordinates: Normalized relative rink coordinates. Rink extents and aspect ratio are approximate; metric distance and speed are disabled.
path_gaps: Missing detection, unreviewed identity, hidden feet, invalid camera or abrupt displacement breaks the path. No interpolation across missing observations.
ball_method: Existing NBHL ball detector, confidence and ambiguity gates, floor bounds and temporal support. Floor-projected estimates only; this segment's ball accuracy is unmeasured.
evaluation_scope: Development demonstration on a previously used game. Floor labels were refined from raw paint after inspecting initial aggregate errors. Held out from the global fit does not mean blind or independent evaluation.
